emperor.name: GAIVS IVLIVS CAESAR OCTAVIANVS
emperor.description: The first Roman Emperor. Great-nephew and adopted son of Julius Caesar. Became de facto Emperor as a result of the settlement with the Roman Senate. Died by natural causes.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR DIVI FILIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: The first Roman Emperor. Great-nephew and adopted son of Julius Caesar. Became de facto Emperor as a result of the settlement with the Roman Senate. On 16 January 27 BC the Roman Senate granted him the additional name Augustus. Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR DIVI FILIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: The first Roman Emperor. Great-nephew and adopted son of Julius Caesar. Became de facto Emperor as a result of the settlement with the Roman Senate. On 16 January 27 BC the Roman Senate granted him the additional name Augustus. Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: LIVIA DRVSILLA | IVLIA AVGUSTA
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Augustus (married 39 BC). Mother of Emperor Tiberius. Mother of Nero Claudius Drusus, the father of Germanicus Caesar and the grandfather of Emperor Caligula. Was granted the title Augusta and the new name Julia Augusta after the death of Augustus (14 AD). Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: MARCVS VIPSANIVS AGRIPPA
emperor.description: A close friend, son-in-law, and lieutenant to Emperor Augustus. Husband to Julia the Elder, daughter of Augustus. Father of Gaius Caesar and Lucius Caesar; both adopted by Augustus. Died by natural causes.

emperor.name: GAIVS VIPSANIVS AGRIPPA IVLIVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Marcus Agrippa and Julia the Elder, daughter of Augustus. Adopted by Augustus together with his brother Lucius Caesar. Wounded in a battle. Died of illness, caused by the wound.

emperor.name: LVCIVS VIPSANIVS AGRIPPA IVLIVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Marcus Agrippa and Julia the Elder, daughter of Augustus. Adopted by Augustus together with his brother Lucius Caesar. Died of illness.

emperor.name: TIBERIVS IVLIVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Livia Drusilla, Augustus' third wife, by a previous marriage; adopted by Augustus. Stepbrother and third husband of Julia the Elder, daughter of Emperor Augustus. Suceeded his adoptive father Augustus. Died by natural causes, possibly assassinated by Caligula or Praetorian Prefect.

emperor.name: TIBERIVS IVLIVS CAESAR AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Livia Drusilla, Augustus' third wife, by a previous marriage; adopted by Augustus. Stepbrother and third husband of Julia the Elder, daughter of Emperor Augustus. Suceeded his adoptive father Augustus. Died by natural causes, possibly assassinated by Caligula or Praetorian Prefect.

emperor.name: NERO CLAVDIVS DRVSVS GERMANICVS
emperor.description: Son of Livia Drusilla, Augustus' third wife, by a previous marriage; adopted by Augustus. Married to Antonia Minor (16 BC). Father of Germanicus Caesar and Emperor Claudius, grandfather of Emperor Gaius Caligula. Died by natural causes after fall from a horse.

emperor.name: ANTONIA AVGUSTA MINOR
emperor.description: Daughter of Marcus Antonius and Octavia, sister of Emperor Augustus. Married to Nero Claudius Drusus (16 BC). Mother of Germanicus Caesar and Emperor Claudius. Grandmother of Emperor Gaius Caligula. Received the title Augusta from Caligula (37). According to other sources, the title Augusta was granted in 41 posthumous by Claudius. Committed suicide, probably forced by Caligula.

emperor.name: GERMANICVS IVLIVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Nero Claudius Drusus, legal stepson of Emperor Augustus, and Empress Antonia Minor. Nephew of Emperor Tiberius, older brother of Emperor Claudius, father of Emperor Caligula. Adopted by Tiberius. Died on natural causes, probably poisoned.

emperor.name: AGRIPPINA GERMANICI
emperor.description: Daughter of Marcus Agrippa, granddaughter of Emperor Augustus. Wife of Germanicus Caesar, married 4 AD. Mother of Emperor Caligula and Empress Agrippina Minor. Grandmother of Emperor Nero. Died on natural causes, probably suicide.

emperor.name: DRVSVS IVLIVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Tiberius and his first wife, Vipsania Agrippina. Heir to the Empire following the death of his adoptive brother Germanicus. Died, seemingly from natural causes.

emperor.name: GAIVS IVLIVS CAESAR AVGVSTVS GERMANICVS
emperor.description: Great-nephew and adoptive grandson of Emperor Tiberius; natural son of Germanicus Caesar. Great-grandson of Emperor Augustus. Succeeded his adoptive grandfather Tiberius. Assassinated in a conspiracy involving senators and Praetorian Guards. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: TIBERIVS CLAVDIVS CAESAR AVGVSTVS GERMANICVS
emperor.description: Uncle of Emperor Caligula; brother of Germanicus Caesar; nephew of Emperor Tiberius. Son of Nero Claudius Drusus and Empress Antonia Minor. Great-nephew and step-grandson of Emperor Augustus; Proclaimed Emperor by Praetorian Guard after the death of Caligula. Died by natural causes, probably poisoned by his wife Agrippina the Younger, in favour of her son Nero. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: VALERIA MESSALINA AVGUSTA
emperor.description: Granddaughter of Antonia Major, the niece of Emperor Augustus. Cousin of Emperor Nero. The third wife of Emperor Claudius. Became Empress as Claudius became Emperor in 41. Mother of Britannicus Caesar and Claudia Octavia. Executed by the Pretorian Guard after betrayal of Claudius. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: TIBERIVS CLAVDIVS CAESAR BRITANNICVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Claudius and Valeria Messalina. Step-brother of Emperor Nero. He was born after his father Claudis became Emperor. After the death of Claudius, Britannicus was poisoned.

emperor.name: AGRIPPINA AVGVSTA
emperor.description: Daughter of Gemanicus Caesar and Agrippina Maior, a granddaughter of Emperor Augustus. Sister of Emperor Gaius Caligula. Mother of Emperor Nero. 4th wife of Emperor Claudius (married 49). Granted the title of Augusta by Claudius (50). Ruled togerther with her husband Claudius and later (54) with her son Nero. Assassinated under unknown circumstances. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: NERO CLAVDIVS CAESAR DRVSVS GERMANICVS
emperor.description: Great-nephew, stepson, son-in-law and adopted son of Emperor Claudius. Nephew of Emperor Caligula; great-great-nephew of of Emperor Tiberius. Grandson of Germanicus Caesar; great-great-grandson of Augustus. Adopted and elevated to Caesar (50) by Claudius after Nero's mother Agrippina Minor besame wife of Claudius. Became Emperor (54) after the death of Claudius. Committed suicide after being declared a public enemy by the Senate.

emperor.name: NERO CLAVDIVS CAESAR AVGVSTVS GERMANICVS
emperor.description: Great-nephew, stepson, son-in-law and adopted son of Emperor Claudius. Nephew of Emperor Caligula; great-great-nephew of of Emperor Tiberius. Grandson of Germanicus Caesar; great-great-grandson of Augustus. Became Emperor with the consent of Praetorian Guard. Committed suicide after being declared a public enemy by the Senate. Last of Julian-Claudian dynasty. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: CLAVDIA OCTAVIA AVGUSTA
emperor.description: Daughter of Emperor Claudius and Empress Valeria Messalina. Sister of Britannicus Caesar. Merried Emperor Nero in 53 and became Empress in 54 as Nero became Emperor. Nero divorced Claudia in 62 to marry Poppaea. Exiled and executed short after the divorce.

emperor.name: POPPAEA SABINA AVGVSTA
emperor.description: Also known as Ollia. Married future Emperor Otho (58), probably to be close to Emperor Nero. Divorced Otho (58-59) and married Nero (62). Became Augusta in 63. Killed by Nero, probably in "casual outburst". Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR SERVIVS SVLPICIVS GALBA CAESAR AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Consul (33) and Governor (Praetor or Proconsul) in Aquitania (ca. 30), Africa (44-45), Hispania (54-68). Proclaimed Emperor as result of the revolt in Hispania Tarraconensis (April 68). Supported by Praetorian Guard and recognized the Senate after the suicide of Emperor Nero. Murdered by Praetorin Guard in the coup, lead by Emperor Otho. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR MARKVS OTHO CAESAR AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Friend of Emperor Nero. Governor of province Lusitania. Allied with Emperor Galba during the revolt of 68. Murdered Galba in 69 and proclaimed himself Emperor. Committed suicide after the defeat against Vitellius. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR AVLVS VITELLIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Consul (48) and Governor (Proconsul) in Africa (60 or 61). Military Commander in Germania Inferior under Emperor Galba. Proclaimed Emperor by the Rheine legions (Germania Inferior and Superior) in opposition to Emperor Galba and Emperor Otho. Vitellius was recongnized as Emperor by the Senate after defeating the armies of Otho and Otho's suicide. Defeated by the army of Emperor Vespasianus. Murdered after the defeat. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR TITVS FLAVIVS CAESAR VESPASIANVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Founder of the Flavian dynasty. Vespasian was legate of Legio II Augusta. Proclaimed Emperor in Judaea. Seized power with the support of the eastern Legions in the Year of the Four Emperors (69). Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: DIVVS AVGVSTVS VESPASIANVS
emperor.description: Founder of the Flavian dynasty. Vespasian was legate of Legio II Augusta. Proclaimed Emperor in Judaea. Seized power with the support of the eastern Legions in the Year of the Four Emperors (69). Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: TITVS FLAVIVS CAESAR VESPASIANVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Vespasian, brother of Emperor Domitian. Became Emperor in 79, succeeding his father Vespasian. Died by natural causes.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR TITVS FLAVIVS CAESAR VESPASIANVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Vespasian, brother of Emperor Domitian. Succeeded his father Vespasian. Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IVLIA TITI FLAVIA AVGVSTA
emperor.description: Daugther of Emperor Titus. Niece of Emperor Domitian. Made Augusta by her grandfather Emperor Vespasian. After execution of her husband by Domitian in 82, lived with Domitian 'as a wife'. Died by natural causes, probably after abortion, forced by Domitian.

emperor.name: TITVS FLAVIVS CAESAR DOMITIANVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Vespasian, brother of Emperor Titus. Became Emperor in 81, succeeding his brother Titus. Assassinated in a conspiracy by court officials.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR TITVS FLAVIVS CAESAR DOMITIANVS AVGVSTVS GERMANICVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Vespasian, brother of Emperor Titus. Succeeded his brother Titus. Assassinated in a conspiracy by court officials. Last of Flavian dynasty. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: DOMITIA LONGINA AVGVSTA
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Domitianus (married 71). Her maternal grandmother was Junia Lepida, a great-great-granddaughter of Emperor Augustus. Her paternal aunt was Empress Milonia Caesonia, wife of Emperor Caligula. Became Augusta upon Domitian's accession in 81 until his assassination in 96. Died by natural causes.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR MARCVS COCCEIVS NERVA CAESAR AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Nerva was Senator and two times Consul, when declared Emperor by the Senate after the assassination of Emperor Domitian. First of the “Five Good Emperors” (Nerva-Antonine dynasty). Adoptive father of Emperor Trajan. Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR NERVA TRAIANVS DIVI NERVAE FILIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Adopted son of Emperor Nerva. Succeeded his adoptive father Nerva. Declared by the Senate optimus princeps (best ruler). Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR NERVA TRAIANVS DIVI NERVAE FILIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Adopted son of Emperor Nerva. Succeeded his adoptive father Nerva. Declared by the Senate optimus princeps (best ruler). Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: POMPEIA PLOTINA AVGVSTA
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Trajan (married before the succession of Trajan in 98). Received the title Augusta in 100, did not accept the title until 105. Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: VLPIA MARCIANA AVGVSTA
emperor.description: Elder sister of Emperor Trajan. Mother of Salonia Matidia. Received the title of Augusta from her brother Trajan. Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: SALONIA MATIDIA AVGVSTA
emperor.description: Daughter of Ulpia Marciana (sister of Emperor Trajan). Received the title of Augusta from Trajan upon the death and divinization of Ulpia Marciana. Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR PVBLIVS AELIVS TRAIANVS HADRIANVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Nephew (his father was cousin of Trajan) and supposedly adopted son of Emperor Trajan. Succeeded Trajan. Adoptive father of Lucius Aelius Caesar and Emperor Antoninus Pius. Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: VIBIA SABINA AVGVSTA
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Hadrian (married ca. 100). Daughter of Salonia Matidia (niece of Emperor Trajan). Received the title Augusta in 119. Died by natural causes, may be suicide. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: LVCIVS AELIVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Adopted by Emperor Hadrian (136). Father of Emperor Lucius Verus. Died by natural causes.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR TITVS AELIVS CAESAR HADRIANVS ANTONINVS
emperor.description: Adopted son of Emperor Hadrian. Married with Faustina Maior, niece of Handrian. Succeeded his adoptive father Hadrian. Adoptive father of Emperor Marcus Aurelius and Emperor Lucius Verus. Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR TITVS AELIVS HADRIANVS ANTONINVS AVGVSTVS PIVS
emperor.description: Adopted son of Emperor Hadrian. Married with Faustina Maior, niece of Handrian. Succeeded his adoptive father Hadrian. Adoptive father of Emperor Marcus Aurelius and Emperor Lucius Verus. Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR TITVS AELIVS HADRIANVS ANTONINVS AVGVSTVS PIVS
emperor.description: Adopted son of Emperor Hadrian. Married with Faustina Maior, niece of the Handrian. Succeeded his adoptive father Hadrian. Adoptive father of Emperor Marcus Aurelius and Emperor Lucius Verus. Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: ANNIA GALERIA FAVSTINA AVGUSTA MAIOR
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Antoninus Pius (married between 110 and 115). Niece of Vibia Sabina Augusta and Emperor Handrian. Mother of Faustina Augusta Minor. Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: ANNIA GALERIA FAVSTINA AVGUSTA MAIOR
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Antoninus Pius (married between 110 and 115). Niece of Vibia Sabina Augusta and Emperor Handrian. Mother of Faustina Augusta Minor. Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: MARCVS AELIVS AVRELIVS VERVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Adopted son and son-in-law of Emperor Antoninus Pius. Nephew of Faustina Maior. Married to Faustina Minor, dauther of Antoninus Pius and Faustina Maior. Became Emperor, succeeding Antoninus Pius. Father of Emperor Commodus. Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS AVRELIVS ANTONINVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Adopted son (138) and son-in-law of Emperor Antoninus Pius. Nephew of Faustina Maior. Married to Faustina Minor (145), dauther of Antoninus Pius and Faustina Maior. Succeeded his adoptive father Antoninus Pius. Co-Emperor with Lucius Verus until 169. Last of the "Five Good Emperors". Father of Emperor Commodus. Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS AVRELIVS ANTONINVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Adopted son (138) and son-in-law of Emperor Antoninus Pius. Nephew of Faustina Maior. Married to Faustina Minor (145), dauther of Antoninus Pius and Faustina Maior. Succeeded his adoptive father Antoninus Pius. Father of Emperor Commodus. Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: ANNIA GALERIA FAVSTINA AVGUSTA MINOR
emperor.description: Daughter of Emperor Antoninus Pius and Faustina Maior. Wife of Emperor Marcus Aurelius (married 13 May 145). Mother of Emperor Commodus. Died after an accident. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: ANNIA GALERIA FAVSTINA AVGUSTA MINOR
emperor.description: Daughter of Emperor Antoninus Pius and Faustina Maior. Wife of Emperor Marcus Aurelius (married 13 May 145). Mother of Emperor Commodus. Died after an accident. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR LVCIVS AVRELIVS VERVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Aelius Caesar. Adopted son of Emperor Antoninus Pius and son-in-law of Emperor Marcus Aurelius. Married to Lucilla, dauther of Marcus Aurelius and Faustina Minor. Succeeded adoptive father Antoninus Pius. Co-Emperor with Marcus Aurelius. Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR LVCIVS AVRELIVS VERVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Aelius Caesar. Adopted son of Emperor Antoninus Pius and son-in-law of Emperor Marcus Aurelius. Succeeded adoptive father Antoninus Pius. Co-Emperor with Marcus Aurelius. Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: ANNIA AVRELIA GALERIA LVCILLA AVGUSTA
emperor.description: Daughter of Emperor Marcus Aurelius and wife of Emperor Lucius Verus (married 164). Executed after being involved in a failed conspiracy to assassinate Commodus.

emperor.name: LVCIVS AVRELIVS COMMODVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Marcus Aurelius and Faustina Minor. Co-Emperor with his father from June 177. Became sole Emperor after death of Marcus Aurelius. Assassinated in a conspiracy.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR LVCIVS AELIVS AVRELIVS COMMODVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Marcus Aurelius and Faustina Minor. Co-Emperor with his father from June 177. From 17 March 180 - sole Emperor. Assassinated in a conspiracy. Declared a public enemy by the Senate - de facto damnatio memoriae. Later consecrated (apotheosis) by Septimius Severus.

emperor.name: BRVTTIA CRISPINA AVGVSTA
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Commodus (married 178). Crispina was charged with adultery by her husband and was banished to the island of Capri in 188, later executed. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR PVBLIVS HELVIVS PERTINAX AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of freedman, military commander, senator and governor of multiple provinces under rule of Emperor Marcus Aurelius. Served as urban prefect of Rome during reign of Emperor Commodus. Proclaimed Emperor by the Praetorian Guard after assasination of Commodus. Murdered by rebelling soldiers of the Praetorian Guard. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR LVCIVS SEPTIMIVS SEVERVS EVSEBES PERTINAX AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Seized power after the death of Emperor Pertinax during the Year of the Five Emperors (193). Septimius Severus was governor of Pannonia Superior, when proclaimed Emperor by Pannonian legions. Founder of the Severan dynasty. Father of Emperor Caracalla and Emperor Geta. Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: DECIMVS CLODIVS SEPTIMIVS ALBINVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Claimed the title Emperor in the Year of the Five Emperors (193). Adopted by Emperor Septimius Severus (193), received the title Caesar. Proclaimed himself Emperor (196), supported by British and Spanish legions. Defeated by Septimius Severus, committed suicide afterwards. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR DECIMVS CLODIVS SEPTIMIVS ALBINVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Claimed the title Emperor in the Year of the Five Emperors (193). Adopted by Emperor Septimius Severus (193), received the title Caesar. Proclaimed himself Emperor (196), supported by British and Spanish legions. Defeated by Septimius Severus, committed suicide afterwards. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: IVLIA DOMNA AVGUSTA
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Septimius Severus (married 185). Mother of Emperor Caracalla and Emperor Geta. Sister of Julia Maesa. Aunt to Julia Soaemias and Julia Mamaea. Commited suicide after assassination of Caracalla. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: MARCVS AVRELIVS ANTONINVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Septimius Severus; brother of Emperor Geta. Received the title Caeser from his father Septimius Severus. Became Co-Emperor with Septimius Severus in Autumn 197. Assassinated by a soldier as part of a conspiracy involving Praetorian Prefect Macrinus, later Emperor.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS AVRELIVS SEVERVS ANTONINVS PIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Septimius Severus; brother of Emperor Geta. Received the title Augustus from his father Septimius Severus (197). Co-Emperor with Septimius Severus from 197, with Septimius Severus and Geta from 209 until February 211. Co-Emperor with Geta until December 211. Sole Emperor after the death of Geta. Assassinated by a soldier as part of a conspiracy involving Praetorian Prefect Macrinus, later Emperor.

emperor.name: PVBLIA FVLVIA PLAVTILLA AVGVSTA
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Caracalla, her paternal second cousin (married April 202). Daughter of Gaius Fulvius Plautianus, friend and Praetorian Prefect of Emperor Septimius Severus. Was sent to exile by Caracalla (January 205), after her father was executed for treachery. Assassinated on orders of Caracalla after the death of Septimius Severus (211).

emperor.name: PVBLIVS SEPTIMIVS GETA CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Septimius Severus; brother of Emperor Caracalla. Received the title Augustus from his father Septimius Severus (209). Assassinated by Praetorian Guards on orders of Caracalla.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR PVBLIVS SEPTIMIVS GETA AVGVSTUS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Septimius Severus; brother of Emperor Caracalla. Received the title Augustus from his father Septimius Severus (209). Co-Emperor with Septimius Severus and Caracalla from 209 until February 211. Co-Emperor with Caracalla until December 211. Assassinated by Praetorian Guards on orders of Caracalla. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS OPELLIVS SEVERVS MACRINVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Praetorian Prefect to Caracalla. Conspired to have Caracalla murdered and proclaimed himself Emperor after Caracalla's death. Made his son Diadumenian co-Emperor in May 218. Executed after his troops were defeated by legions of Elagabalus. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: MARCVS OPELLIVS ANTONINVS DIADVMENIANVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Macrinus. Elevated to Caesar my his father Macrinus in May 217 and to Augustus in May 218. Executed after his father Macrinus was defeated by legions of Elagabalus.

emperor.name: IVLIA MAESA AVGVSTA
emperor.description: Elder sister of Julia Domna, sister-in-law to Emperor Septimius Severus. Aunt of Emperor Caracalla and Emperor Geta. Mother of Julia Soaemias and Julia Mamaea. Grandmother and co-regent of Emperor Elagabalus and Emperor Severus Alexander. Received the title Augusta in 218 after Elagabalus became Emperor. Died by natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS AVRELIVS ANTONINVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Grandnephew of Julia Domna and Emperor Septimius Severus. First cousin once removed and alleged illegitimate son of Emperor Caracalla. Grandson of Julia Maesa, son of Julia Soaemias. Cousin of Emperor Severus Alexander. Adopted Severus Alexander as his hair. Proclaimed Emperor by Syrian legions in a conspiracy, organized by Julia Maesa against Macrinus. Murdered in a riot by Praetorian Guard. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: IVLIA SOAEMIAS AVGUSTA
emperor.description: Niece of Julia Domna and Emperor Septimius Severus. Daughter of Julia Maesa, sister of Julia Mamaea. Mother and co-regent of Emperor Elagabalus. Received the title Augusta in 218 after Elagabalus became Emperor. Murdered in a riot by Praetorian Guard together with her son Elagabalus. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: IVLIA CORNELIA PAVLA AVGUSTA
emperor.description: First wife of Emperor Elagabalus (married in early 219). Elagabalus divorced her in late 220. Withdrew from public life after the divorce.

emperor.name: IVLIA AQVILIA SEVERA AVGUSTA
emperor.description: Second and fourth wife of Emperor Elagabalus (married in late 220, divorced, marriage revoked in 221). Received the title Augusta after the first marriage with Elagabalus. Lost the title after the assassination of Elagabalus (222). Cause and date of death are unknown.

emperor.name: ANNIA AVRELIA FAVSTINA AVGUSTA
emperor.description: Third wife of Emperor Elagabalus (married in July 221, divorced by the end of 221). Great-granddaughter of Emperor Marcus Aurelius. Received the title Augusta after the marriage with Elagabalus. Cause and date of death are unknown.

emperor.name: IVLIA AVITA MAMAEA AVGVSTA
emperor.description: Niece of Julia Domna and Emperor Septimius Severus. Daughter of Julia Maesa, sister of Julia Soaemias. Mother and co-regent of Emperor Severus Alexander. Received the title Augusta in 222 after Severus Alexander became Emperor. Lynched by soldiers together with her son Severus Alexander. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: MARCVS AVRELIVS ALEXANDER CAESAR
emperor.description: Grandnephew of Julia Domna and Emperor Septimius Severus. First cousin once removed of Emperor Caracalla. Grandson of Julia Maesa, son of Julia Soaemias. Cousin of Emperor Elagabalus. Adopted by Elagabalus and made Caesar in 221. Succeeded his cousin Elagabalus. Lynched by soldiers, after Maximinus Thrax was proclaimed Emperor. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS AVRELIVS SEVERVS ALEXANDER AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Grandnephew of Julia Domna and Emperor Septimius Severus. First cousin once removed of Emperor Caracalla. Grandson of Julia Maesa, son of Julia Soaemias. Cousin of Emperor Elagabalus. Adopted by Elagabalus. Succeeded his cousin Elagabalus. Lynched by soldiers, after Maximinus Thrax was proclaimed Emperor. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: GNAEA SEIA HERENNIA SALLVSTIA BARBIA ORBIANA AVGUSTA
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Severus Alexander (married 225). Received the title Augusta after the marrige to Severus Alexander. Sent to exile after the failed coup of her father, Praetorian Prefect and Caesar Lucius Seius Herennius Sallustius. Lived in Africa. Date and cause of death are unknown.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR GAIVS IVLIVS VERVS MAXIMINVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Maximinus was Prefect of Legio IV Italica, when proclaimed Emperor by Germanic legions after assassination of Emperor Severus Alexander. Assassinated by his soldiers in the Year of the Six Emperors (238). Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: CAECILIA PAVLINA PIA AVGUSTA
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Maximinus Thrax. Mother of Maximus Caesar. Probably died before Maximinus became Emperor. Received the title Augusta posthumously. Deified (Diva).

emperor.name: GAIVS IVLIVS VERVS MAXIMVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Maximinus I Thrax. Maximinus I Thrax appointed his son Caesar around 236. Assassinated by soldiers together with his father.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR DECIMVS CAELIVS CALVINVS BALBINVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Roman senator, Consul 211 and 213 as colleague of Caracalla. Co-Emperor with Pupienus in the Year of the Six Emperors (238). Was installed as Emperor by the Senate after defeat and deaths of Emperors Gordian I and Gordian II against Emperor Maximinus Thrax. After the death of Maximinux Thrax, Pupienus and Balbinus have been assasinated by the Praetorian Guard, who resented serving under Senate-appointed Emperors.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS CLODIVS PVPIENVS MAXIMVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Roman senator, Consul 222 and 234. Co-Emperor with Balbinus in the Year of the Six Emperors (238). Was installed as Emperor by the Senate after defeat and deaths of Emperors Gordian I and Gordian II against Emperor Maximinus Thrax. After the death of Maximinux Thrax, Pupienus and Balbinus have been assasinated by the Praetorian Guard, who resented serving under Senate-appointed Emperors.

emperor.name: MARCVS ANTONIVS GORDIANVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Grandson of Emperor Gordian I and nephew of Emperor Gordian II. Raised to Caesar by the Senate during the reign of Emperors Balbinus and Pupienus in the Year of the Six Emperors. Died by unknown causes. Possibly assassinated on orders of Philip I Arab. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS ANTONIVS GORDIANVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Grandson of Emperor Gordian I and nephew of Emperor Gordian II. Raised to Caesar by the Senate during the reign of Emperors Balbinus and Pupienus in the Year of the Six Emperors. Proclaimed Emperor by the Praetorian Guard, then by the Senate, after the assassination of Balbinus and Pupienus. Died by unknown causes. Possibly assassinated on orders of Philip I Arab. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: FVRIA SABINIA TRANQVILLINA AVGVSTA
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Gordian III. Daughter of Timesitheus, the Praetorian Prefect of Gordian III. Survived assassination of Gordian III. Date and causes of death are unknown.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS IVLIVS PHILIPPVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Praetorian Prefect to Emperor Gordian III. Took power after death of Gordian III. Appointed his son Philip II co-Emperor in Summer 247. Killed in the battle against Emperor Trajanus Decius. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: MARCIA OTACILIA SEVERA AVGVSTA
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Philip I Arab. Mother of Emperor Philippus II. Received the title Augusta after Philip I Arab became Emperor. Survived her husband and son and lived later in obscurity.

emperor.name: MARCVS IVLIVS SEVERVS PHILLIPVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Philip I Arab. Appointed Caesar in 244, when his father became Emperor. Co-Emperor from Summer 247. Assassinated by Praetorian Guard, when news of death of Philip I Arab reached Rome.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS IVLIVS SEVERVS PHILLIPVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Philip I Arab. Appointed Caesar in 244, when his father became Emperor. Co-Emperor from Summer 247. Assassinated by Praetorian Guard, when news of death of Philip I Arab reached Rome.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR GAIVS MESSIVS QVINTVS TRAIANVS DECIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Propraetor of Moesian and Pannonian provinces during reign Emperor Philip I Arab. Proclaimed Emperor by his troops. Recognized as Emperor by Senate after defeating Philip I Arab. Father of Emperor Herennius Etruscus and Emperor Hostilian. Killed in the battle against Goths together with Herennius Etruscus. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: ANNIA CVPRESSENIA HERENNIA ETRVSCILLA AVGVSTA
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Trajan Decius (married ca. 230). Mother of Emperor Herennius Etruscus and Emperor Hostilian. Received the title Augusta after Trajan Decius became Emperor. Co-regent of Hostilian. Probably died of plague in 251.

emperor.name: QVINTVS HERENNIVS ETRVSCVS MESSIVS DECIVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Trajanus Decius and Herennia Etruscilla. Brother of Emperor Hostilian. Appointed Caesar by his father Trajanus Decius. Co-Emperor with Trajanus Decius in June 251. Killed in the battle against Goths together with his father.

emperor.name: GAIVS VALENS HOSTILIANVS MESSIVS QVINTVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Trajanus Decius and Herennia Etruscilla. Brother of Emperor Herennius Etruscus. Appointed Caesar by his father Trajanus Decius. Became Emperor in June 251. Co-Emperor with Trebonianus Gallus. Died of plague.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR GAIVS VALENS HOSTILIANVS MESSIVS QVINTVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Trajanus Decius and Herennia Etruscilla. Brother of Emperor Herennius Etruscus. Appointed Caesar by his father Trajanus Decius. Adopted by Emperor Trebonianus Gallus after death of Trajanus Decius. Accepted as Emperor by Senate. Co-Emperor with Trebonianus Gallus. Died of plague.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR GAIVS VIBIVS AFINIVS TREBONIANVS GALLVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Propraetor of Moesia Superior under Emperor Trajanus Decius. Proclaimed Emperor by Danubian legions after death of Trajanus Decius. Adopted and accepted Hostilian as co-Emperor. Made his son Volusianus co-Emperor in late 251. Assassinated by his own troops, in favour of Emperor Aemilianus. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR GAIVS VIBIVS VOLVSIANVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Trebonianus Gallus. Elevated to Caesar in about July 251 by his father. Became co-Emperor with Trebonianus Gallus after death of Emperor Hostilianus. Assassinated by own troops together with his father Trebonianus Gallus.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS AEMILIVS AEMILIANVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Propraetor of Moesia Superior under Emperor Trebonianus Gallus. Proclaimed Emperor by Danubian legions. Defaeted Trebonianus Gallus and Volusianus. Recognized by Senate after death of Trebonianus Gallus. Assassinated by his own troops, in favour of Emperor Valerianus.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR PVBLIVS LICINIVS VALERIANVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Governor of Noricum and Raetia under Emperor Trebonianus Gallus. Proclaimed Emperor by Rhine legions after death of Trebonianus Gallus; accepted as Emperor after death of Emperor Aemilianus. Made his son Galienus co-Emperor. Taken captive by the Persians. Died in captivity.

emperor.name: EGNATIA MARINIANA AVGVSTA
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Valerianus (married before 250). Mother of Emperor Gallienus. Died before Valerianus became Emperor. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR PVBLIVS LICINIVS EGNATIVS GALLIENVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Valerianus and Mariniana. Became co-Emperor with his father Valerianus (253). Made co-Emperor his son Saloninus in July 260 for a short time. Sole Emperor after Valerianus was taken caprive and assasination of Saloninus. Assisinated by his soldiers during the revolt of Aureolus. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IVLIA CORNELIA SALONINA AVGVSTA
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Gallienus. Mother of Valerianus II Caesar and Emperor Saloninus. Salonina was named Augusta after Gallienus became co-Emperor with Valerianus. Probably assasinated together with her husband Gallienus.

emperor.name: PVBLIVS LICINIVS CORNELIVS EGNATIVS VALERIANVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Gallienus and Salonina. Valerianus II was made Caesar shortly after his father became co-Emperor with Emperor Valerianus I. Died in suspicious circumstances, probably during the attempted usurpation by Ingenuus. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: PVBLIVS LICINIVS CORNELIVS EGNATIVS VALERIANVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Gallienus and Salonina. Valerianus II was made Caesar shortly after his father became co-Emperor with Emperor Valerianus I. Died in suspicious circumstances, probably during the attempted usurpation by Ingenuus. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: PVBLIVS CORNELIVS LICINIVS SALONINVS VALERIANVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Gallienus and Salonina. Brother of Valerianus II Caesar. Became Caesar after the death of his brother Valerianus II. Saloninus was briefly co-Emperor in July 260 with his father Gallienus. Assasinated by soldiers during the usurpation of Postumus.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR TITVS FVLVIVS IVNIVS MACRIANVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Served as military tribune under Emperor Valerianus in the Persian campain (260). Proclaimed Emperor by his father Macrianus Maior after Valerianus was taken captive by Persians. Brother and co-Emperor of Quietus. Killed in the battle against the army of Emperor Gallienus, commanded by Aureolus.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR TITVS FVLVIVS IVNIVS QVIETVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Served as military tribune under Emperor Valerianus in the Persian campain (260). Proclaimed Emperor by his father Macrianus Maior after Valerianus was taken captive by Persians. Brother and co-Emperor of Macrianus Minor. Assasinated after the defeat and deaths of his brother Macrianus Minor and father Macrianus Maior.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS CASSIANIVS LATINIVS POSTVMVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Military commander in Gallia under Saloninus Caesar and Emperors Valerianus and Gallienus . Founder of the Gallic Roman Empire (Imperium Galliarum). Proclaimed Emperor by Gallian legions during the invasion of Alamanni and Franks after news of the defeat and capture of Emperor Valerianus. Lynched by his own soldiers after the revolt of the usurper Laelianus.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS AVRELIVS MARIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: An officer in the army of Emperor Postumus. Proclaimed Emperor of the Gallic Empire by soldiers after assassinaation of Postumus. Killed by Emperror Victorinus.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS PIAVONIVS VICTORINVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Praetorian Prefect and Consul of the Gallic Empire under Emperor Postumus. Declared Emperor by the troops at Augusta Treverorum (Trier) after the death of Postumus and the short reign of Emperor Marius. Murdered by one of his officers, whose wife Victorinus had supposedly seduced.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR GAIVS PIVS ESVVIVS TETRICVS
emperor.description: Governor (Praeses Provinciae) of Gallia Aquitania under Emperor Victorinus. Appointed Emperor by Victoria, mother of Victorinus, after the assassination of Victorinus. The last Emperor of the Gallic Empire. Tetricus was defeated by Aurelianus in March 274. After the defeat was appointed Governor (Corrector) of either Lucania et Bruttii, a province in southern Italy or all of Italy. Died of natural causes.

emperor.name: GAIVS PIVS ESVVIVS TETRICVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Gallic Emperor Tetricus I. Was raised to the rank of Caesar by his father Tetricus I. Lost the title Caesar after Tetricus I was defeated by Emperor Aurelianus. According to some sources, Tetricus II had kept his senatorial rank. Date and causes of death are unknown.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS AVRELIVS VALERIVS CLAVDIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: General in the army of Emperor Gallienus. Proclaimed Emperor after the assasination of Gallienus. Brother of Emperor Quintillus. Died by natural causes (plague). Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS AVRELIVS VALERIVS CLAVDIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: General in the army of Emperor Gallienus. Proclaimed Emperor after the assasination of Gallienus. Brother of Emperor Quintillus. Died by natural causes (plague). Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS AVRELIVS CLAVDIVS QVINTILLVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Brother of Emperor Claudius II Gothicus. Declared Emperor by the Senate upon the death of Claudius Gothicus. The cause of death is unclear; possibly suicide or assasination.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR LVCIVS DOMITIVS AVRELIANVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: General under Emperor Claudius II Gothicus. Proclaimed Emperor by Danubian legions after the death of Claudius Gothicus, in opposition to Emperor Quintillus. Sole Emperor after the death of Quintillus. Assassinated by an officer of Praetorian Guard, fearing punishment from the Emperor. Condemned (damnatio memoriae) after his death, but this was reversed and Aurelianus was consecrated (apotheosis) after a short time.

emperor.name: VLPIA SEVERINA AVGVSTA
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Aurelianus. Married before Aurelianus became Emperor (270). Gained the title of Augusta at least by the autumn of 274 (if not before). Severina ruled in her own right (interregnum) between the death of Aurelianus and the election of Emperor Tacitus. Date and cause of her death is unknown.

emperor.name: LVCIVS IVLIVS AVRELIVS SEPTIMIVS VABALLATHVS ATHENODORVS
emperor.description: Rex regum, dux Romanorum (King, Duke under Rome) during the reign of Emperor Aurelianus. Emperor of the Palmyrene Empire. His mother Zenobia ruled as queen regent. Defeated and taken caprive by Emperor Aurelianus. Died in captivity.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS CLAVDIVS TACITVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Princeps Senatus (the first member by precedence of the Senate) under Emperor Aurelianus. Elected by the Senate to replace Emperor Aurelianus, after a short interregnum. Half-brother of Emperor Florianus. Died by natural causes, probably assasinated.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS ANNIVS FLORIANVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Half-brother of Emperor Tacitus. Praetorian Prefect under Tacitus. Elected Emperor by the army in the west after the death of Tacitus. Assassinated by his own troops, in favour of Emperor Probus.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS AVRELIVS PROBVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Governor of the eastern provinces under Emperor Tacitus. Proclaimed Emperor by the eastern armies in opposition to Emperor Florianus. Assassinated by his own troops, in favour of Emperor Carus. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS AVRELIVS CARVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Praetorian Prefect under Emperor Probus. Proclaimed Emperor by the army before or after Probus was assasinated. Father of Emperors Carinus und Numerianus. Made his son Carinus co-Emperor in early 283. Probably died by natural causes (possibly killed by lightning). Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS AVRELIVS CARVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Praetorian Prefect under Emperor Probus. Proclaimed Emperor by the army before or after Probus was assasinated. Probably died by natural causes (possibly killed by lightning). Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: MARCVS AVRELIVS CARINVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Carus. Brother of Emperor Numerianus. Elevated to the tile Caesar by his father Carus (282). Became co-Emperor with his father Carus in early 283. Probably died in battle against Emperor Diocletianus. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: CAESAR MARCVS AVRELIVS CARINVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Carus. Brother of Emperor Numerianus. Became co-Emperor with his father Carus in early 283. Succeeded his father Carus. Co-Emperor with his brother Numerianus. Probably died in battle against Emperor Diocletianus. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: MARCVS AVRELIVS NVMERIVS NVMERIANVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Carus. Brother of Emperor Carinus. Proclaimed Caesar by his father Carus. Became co-Emperor with his brother Carinus after the death of Carus. Cause of the death is unclear; possibly assassinated by his father-in-law. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS AVRELIVS NVMERIVS NVMERIANVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Carus. Brother of Emperor Carinus. Became co-Emperor with his brother Carinus after the death of Carus. Cause of the death is unclear; possibly assassinated by his father-in-law. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: MAGNIA VRBICA AVGVSTA
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Carus. She was (mistakenly?) considered to be wife of Emperor Carinus. Mother of Emperors Carinus and Numerianus. Date and cause of the death are unknown.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR GAIVS AVRELIVS VALERIVS DIOCLETIANVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Military Commander under Emperors Aulerianus, Probus and Carus. Proclaimed Emperor by the army of the East after death of Emperor Numerianus; in opposition to Emperor Carinus. After defeating Carinus in 285, both the Western and the Eastern armies acclaimed Diocletianus as Emperor. Proclaimed Maximianus Herculius as Caesar (July 285). Adopted Maximianus Herculius as senior co-Emperor in the West (286). Emperor in the East from 286. Father of Galeria Valeria Augusta. Father-in-law of Emperor Galerius. Founder of the Tetrarchy (293). Adopted Emperor Galerius as junior co-Emperor (Caesar) and heir in 293. Resigned as Emperor 1 May 305. Died of natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis) in 313.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS AVRELIVS VALERIVS MAXIMIANVS HERCVLIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Military Commander under Emperors Aulerianus, Probus and Carus, serving together with Diocletianus. Proclaimed as Caesar (July 285) and senior co-Emperor in the West (286) by Emperor Diocletianus. Adopted Constantius Chlorus as junior co-Emperor (Caesar) and heir in 293. Father of Emperor Maxentius. Resigned as Emperor 1 May 305 together with Diocletianus. Tried to regain throne with, and then from Maxentius (306-310). Taken captive by Emperor Constantinus I. Committed suicide. Condemned (damnatio memoriae), later consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS AVRELIVS VALERIVS MAXIMIANVS HERCVLIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Military Commander under Emperors Aulerianus, Probus and Carus, serving together with Diocletianus. Proclaimed as Caesar (July 285) and senior co-Emperor in the West (286) by Emperor Diocletianus. Adopted Constantius Chlorus as junior co-Emperor (Caesar) and heir in 293. Father of Emperor Maxentius. Resigned as Emperor 1 May 305 together with Diocletianus. Tried to regain throne with, and then from Maxentius (306-310). Taken captive by Emperor Constantinus I. Committed suicide. Condemned (damnatio memoriae), later consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS AVRELIVS MAVSAEVS CARAUSIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Military Commander under Emperor Maximianus Herculius. Seized power as usurper in Britannia after being appointed to command the British fleet. Defeated by the troops of Constantius Chlorus Caesar. Assassinated by his treasurer Allectus, later usurper in Britannia.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR ALLECTVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Treasurer to usurper Carausius. Assassinated Carausius and seized power as usurper in Britannia. Defeated by the troops of Constantius Chlorus Caesar. Killed in the battle.

emperor.name: FLAVIVS VALERIVS CONSTANTIVS CAESAR HERCVLIVS
emperor.description: Military Commander under Emperor Aurelian; Military Tribune under Emperor Probus. Governor (Praeses Provinciae) of Dalmatia under Emperor Carus. Praetorian Prefect in the West under Emperor Maximianus Herculius. Adopted as junior co-Emperor (Caesar) and heir by Maximianus Herculius (293). Father of Emperor Constantinus I the Great. Married to Helena (until 289). Became Emperor in the West after Maximianus Herculius resigned in 305. Died of natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS FLAVIVS VALERIVS CONSTANTIVS HERCVLIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Military Commander under Emperor Aurelian; Military Tribune under Emperor Probus. Governor (Praeses Provinciae) of Dalmatia under Emperor Carus. Praetorian Prefect in the West under Emperor Maximianus Herculius. Adopted as junior co-Emperor (Caesar) and heir by Maximianus Herculius (293). Father of Emperor Constantinus I the Great. Married to Helena Augusta, mother of Constatinus I (until 289). Succeeded Maximianus Herculius as senior Emperor in the West after Maximianus resigned in 305. Adopted Severus II as junior co-Emperor (Caesar) and heir (305). Died of natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS FLAVIVS VALERIVS CONSTANTIVS HERCVLIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Military Commander under Emperor Aurelian; Military Tribune under Emperor Probus. Governor (Praeses Provinciae) of Dalmatia under Emperor Carus. Praetorian Prefect in the West under Emperor Maximianus Herculius. Adopted as junior co-Emperor (Caesar) and heir by Maximianus Herculius (293). Father of Emperor Constantinus I the Great. Married to Helena Augusta, mother of Constatinus I (until 289). Succeeded Maximianus Herculius as senior Emperor in the West after Maximianus resigned in 305. Adopted Severus II as junior co-Emperor (Caesar) and heir (305). Died of natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: FLAVIA MAXIMIANA THEODORA AVGUSTA
emperor.description: Daughter of Emperor Maximianus Herculius. Second wife of Emperor Constantius I Chlorus (married 293). Mother of Dalmatius Caesar and Hannibalianus Caesar. Cause and date of death are unknown.

emperor.name: GAIVS GALERIVS VALERIVS MAXIMIANVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Military Commander under Emperors Aurelianus and Probus. Adopted as junior co-Emperor (Caesar) and heir by Emperor Diocletianus (293). Married to Galeria Valeria Augusta (293), daughter of Diocletianus. Became Emperor in the East after Diocletianus resigned in 305. Died of natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR GAIVS GALERIVS VALERIVS MAXIMIANVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Military Commander under Emperors Aurelianus and Probus. Adopted as junior co-Emperor (Caesar) and heir by Emperor Diocletianus (293). Married to Galeria Valeria Augusta (293), daughter of Diocletianus. Succeeded Diocletianus as senior Emperor in the East after Diocletianus resigned in 305. Uncle of Emperor Maximinus II Daia. Adopted Maximinus II as junior co-Emperor (Caesar) and heir in the East (305). Appointed Licinius as senoir co-Emperor in the West (308). Died of natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR GAIVS GALERIVS VALERIVS MAXIMIANVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Military Commander under Emperors Aurelianus and Probus. Adopted as junior co-Emperor (Caesar) and heir by Emperor Diocletianus (293). Married to Galeria Valeria Augusta (293), daughter of Diocletianus. Succeeded Diocletianus as senior Emperor in the East after Diocletianus resigned in 305. Uncle of Emperor Maximinus II Daia. Adopted Maximinus II as junior co-Emperor (Caesar) and heir in the East (305). Appointed Licinius as senoir co-Emperor in the West (308). Died of natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: GALERIA VALERIA AVGUSTA
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Galerius (married 293). Daughter of Emperor Diocletianus. Raised to the title of Augusta in November 308, after Galerius became senior Emperor in the East. Afther the death of Galerius, refused the marriage proposal of Emperor Maximinus II Daia. Murdered by the mob on orders of Emperor Licinius.

emperor.name: FLAVIVS VALERIVS SEVERVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Senior army officer, an old friend of Emperor Galerius. Adopted as junior co-Emperor (Caesar) and heir by Emperor Constantius I Chlorus in 305. Promoted to senior Emperor in the West by Galerius after the death of Constantius I. Opposed by Emperors Maxentius and Constantinus I the Great. Taken captive by Maxentius and executed.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS VALERIVS SEVERVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Junior co-Emperor (Caesar) and heir by Emperor Constantius I Chlorus in 305. Promoted to senior Emperor in the West by Galerius after the death of Constantius I. Opposed by Emperors Maxentius and Constantinus I the Great. Taken captive by Maxentius, resigned as Emperor and later executed.

emperor.name: GALERIVS VALERIVS MAXIMINVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Nephew of Emperor Galerius. Adopted as junior co-Emperor (Caesar) and heir by Galerius in 305. Became Emperor after the death of Galerius. Died of natural causes, probably committed suicide. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR GAIVS GALERIVS VALERIVS MAXIMINVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Nephew of Emperor Galerius. Adopted as junior co-Emperor (Caesar) and heir by Galerius in 305. Succeeded Galerius as Emperor in the East in 311. Co-Emperor with Emperor Licinius I. Lost the title Augustus after the defeat in civil war against Licinius. Died of natural causes, probably committed suicide. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MARCVS AVRELIVS VALERIVS MAXENTIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Maximianus Herculius. Brother of Fausta, wife of Emperor Constantinus I. Proclaimed Emperor in the West after the death of Emperor Constantius I Chlorus (306) in opposition to Severus II and Constantinus I. Recognized by the Senate. Accepted Constantinus I as Caesar. Recognized by Constantinus I as senior Emperor. Appointed Caesar in the West by his father Maximianus Herculius (second reign) in 307 after the death of Severus II. Proclaimed senior Emperor himself again in opposition to Licinius. The imperial conference (308) denied recognition of Maxentius as legitimate Emperor. Died at the Battle of the Milvian Bridge, against Constantinus I. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: MARCVS AVRELIVS VALERIVS ROMVLVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Maxentius. Consul in 308. Assigned Caesar by his father in 308. Cause of death is unknown. Raised to Divus on his death by Maxentius. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR GAIVS VALERIVS LICINIANVS LICINIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: A close childhood friend of Emperor Galerius. Married to Flavia Julia Constantia (313), daughter of Emperor Constantius I Chlorus, half-sister of Emperor Constantinus I the Great. Appointed Emperor in the West by Galerius in 308, in opposition to Emperor Maxentius. Became Emperor in the East in 311 after the death of Galerius, shared with Emperor Maximinus II Daia. Defeated Maximinus II Daia in civil war to become sole Emperor in the East (313). Appointed Valerius Valens (317) and Martinianus (324) as Emperors in the West, in opposition to Constantinus I. Licinius was defeated in civil war against Constantinus I in 324 and taken captive. Executed on the orders of Constantinus I in 325. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: VALERIVS LICINIANVS LICINIVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Licinius and Flavia Julia Constantia, daughter of Emperor Constantius I Chlorus. Nephew of Emperor Constantinus I the Great. Raised to the rank of Caesar by his father Licinius. Lost the title Caesar after the defeat of his father by Constantinus I. Executed on the orders of Constantinus I in 326, probably in the context of the execution of Crispus Caesar.

emperor.name: FLAVIVS VALERIVS CONSTANTINVS CAESAR HERCVLIVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Constantius I Chlorus and Helena Augusta. Father of Emperors Constantinus II, Constantius II and Constans. Founder of the Constantinian dynasty. Proclaimed Emperor by his father's legions after death of Constantius Chlorus. Accepted as Caesar in the West by Emperor Galerius in 306. Promoted to Augustus in the West (307) by Emperor Maximianus Herculius after death of Emperor Severus II. Died of natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis). Canonized (Saint Constantine).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS VALERIVS AVRELIVS CONSTANTINVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Constantius I Chlorus and Helena Augusta. Father of Emperors Constantinus II, Constantius II and Constans. Founder of the Constantinian dynasty. Proclaimed Emperor by his father's legions after death of Constantius Chlorus. Accepted as Caesar in the West by Emperor Galerius in 306. Promoted to Augustus in the West (307) by Emperor Maximianus Herculius after death of Emperor Severus II. Co-Emperor with Emperors in the Eeast Galerius (308–311), Maximinus II Daia (311–313), Licinius (313–324). Became the sole Emperor after the civil wars against Emperors Maxentius and Licinius (324). Died of natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis). Canonized (Saint Constantine).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS VALERIVS AVRELIVS CONSTANTINVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Constantius I Chlorus and Helena Augusta. Father of Emperors Constantinus II, Constantius II and Constans. Founder of the Constantinian dynasty. Proclaimed Emperor by his father's legions after death of Constantius Chlorus. Accepted as Caesar in the West by Emperor Galerius in 306. Married to Fausta (307), daughter of Emperor Maximianus Herculius. Promoted to Augustus in the West (307) by Maximianus Herculius after death of Emperor Severus II. Co-Emperor with Emperors in the Eeast Galerius (308–311), Maximinus II Daia (311–313), Licinius (313–324). Became the sole Emperor after the civil wars against Emperors Maxentius and Licinius (324). Died of natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis). Canonized (Saint Constantine).

emperor.name: FLAVIA IVLIA HELENA AVGVSTA
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Constantius I Chlorus (married ca. 270, divorced 289). Mother of Emperor Constaninus I the Great. Received the title of Augusta (Empress) in 325 after her son Constantinus the Great became sole Emperor. Died of natural causes. Canonized (Saint Helena).

emperor.name: FLAVIA MAXIMA FAVSTA AVGVSTA
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Constantinus I the Great (married in 307). Daughter of Emperor Maximianus Herculius. Sister of Emperor Maxentius. Mother of Emperors Constantinus II, Constantius II and Constans. Proclaimed Augusta (Empress) in 325 after her husband Constantinus the Great became sole Emperor. Executed on orders of Constaninus the Great (probably) on a charge of adultery. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: GAIVS FLAVIVS IVLIVS CRISPVS CAESAR
emperor.description: The first-born son of Emperor Constantinus I the Great and Minervina. Half-brother of Emperors Constantinus II, Constantius II and Constans. Declared Caesar by co-Emperors Constantinus I and Licinius I, alongside with his brother Constantinus II and his cousin Licinius II. Executed on orders of Constaninus the Great (probably) on a charge of adultery with Empress Fausta. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: FLAVIVS CLAVDIVS CONSTANTINVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Constantinus I the Great and Fausta. Brother of Emperors Constantius II and Constans. Declared Caesar by co-Emperors Constantinus I and Licinius I, alongside with his half-brother Crispus and his cousin Licinius II. Succeeded his father Constantinus I as Emperor in the West. Died in battle against Constans. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: FLAVIVS IVLIVS CONSTANTIVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Constantinus I the Great and Fausta. Brother of Emperors Constantinus II and Constans. Declared Caesar by his father Constantinus I. Succeeded his father as Emperor in the East. Died of natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: FLAVIVS IVLIVS CONSTANS CAESAR
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Constantinus I the Great and Fausta. Brother of Emperors Constantinus II and Constantius II. Elevated to the rank of Caesar by his father Constantinus II. Succeeded his father as Emperor in Italia and Africa. Assassinated on orders of usurper Magnentius. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: FLAVIVS DELMATIVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Nephew of Emperor Constantinus I the Great. Cousin of Emperors Constantinus II, Constantius II and Constans. Raised to the rank of Caesar by Constantinus I, with the control of Thracia, Achaea and Macedonia. Killed by his own soldiers, probably in the purge in the imperial family, organized by Constantius II after the death of Constantinus I.

emperor.name: FLAVIVS HANNIBALIANVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Nephew of Emperor Constantinus I the Great. Cousin of Emperors Constantinus II, Constantius II and Constans. Brother of Dalmatius Caesar. Married to Constantina (335), daughter of Constantinus I. Hannibalianus was made Caesar (335) and Rex Regum et Ponticarum Gentium "King of the Kings and of the Pontic People" (337). Killed in the purge in the imperial family, organized by Constantius II after the death of Constantinus I.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS CLAVDIVS CONSTANTINVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Constantinus I the Great and Fausta. Brother of Emperors Constantius II and Constans. Declared Caesar by co-Emperors Constantinus I and Licinius I. Succeeded his father Constantinus I as Emperor in the West. Co-Emperor with Constantius II and Constans. Died in battle against Constans. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS IVLIVS CONSTANTIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Constantinus I the Great and Fausta. Brother of Emperors Constantinus II and Constans. Declared Caesar by his father Constantinus I. Succeeded his father as Emperor in the East. Co-Emperor with his brothers Constantinus II and Constans. Sole Emperor afther the death of Constans (350). Died of natural causes during the war against Emperor Julianus II. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS IVLIVS CONSTANS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Constantinus I the Great and Fausta. Brother of Emperors Constantinus II and Constantius II. Elevated to the rank of Caesar by his father Constantinus II. Succeeded his father as Emperor in Italia and Africa. Co-Emperor with with his brothers Constantinus II and Constantius II. Became Emperor in the West after the death of Dalmatius Caesar and defeating Constantinus II. Assassinated on orders of usurper Magnentius. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS VETRANIO AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: General of Emperor Constans, governor in Illyria. Proclaimed Caesar against usurper Magnentius. Temporarily accepted as Emperor in the West by Emperor Constantius II after the assassination of Emperor Constans. Resigned as Emperor in favour of Constantius II. Died of natural causes.

emperor.name: FLAVIVS CLAVDIVS CONSTANTIVS GALLVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Grandson of Emperor Constantius I Chlorus and Theodora. Half-brother of Emperor Julianus II the Apostate. Half-first cousin of Emperors Constantinus II, Constantius II and Constans. Raised to the rank of Caesar by Constantius II during the usurpation of Magnentius. Married to Constantina (Saint Constance), daughter of Constantinus I the Great (351). Sentenced to death by Constantius II for treason (attempt of usurpation).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR MAGNVS MAGNENTIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Military commander under Emperors Constantinus I the Great and Constans. Usurper, proclaimed Emperor by legions in Gallia against Constans. Ordered to kill Constans. Became Emperor in the West. Magnentius was defeated by troops of Emperor Constantius II. Commited suicide after the defeat. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: FLAVIVS MAGNVS DECENTIVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Brother of usurper Magnentius. Elevated to the rank of Caesar by Magnentius. Commited suicide after the defeat and the death of Magnentius.

emperor.name: FLAVIVS CLAVDIVS IVLIANVS CAESAR
emperor.description: Grandson of Emperor Constantius I Chlorus. Nephew of Emperor Constaninus I the Great. Cousin of Emperors Constantinus II, Constans and Constantius II. Made Caesar in the West by Constantius II. Proclaimed Emperor by his troops in 360 against Constantius II. Rejected Christianity and promoted Neoplatonic Hellenism. Named 'the Apostate' by the Christian church. Wounded in the battle against Persians. Died of the wounds a few days later. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS CLAVDIVS IVLIANVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Grandson of Emperor Constantius I Chlorus. Nephew of Emperor Constaninus I the Great. Cousin of Emperors Constantinus II, Constans and Constantius II. Made Caesar in the West by Constantius II (355). Proclaimed Emperor by his troops in 360 against Constantius II. Sole Emperor after the death of Constantius II. Rejected Christianity and promoted Neoplatonic Hellenism. Named 'the Apostate' by the Christian church. Wounded in the battle against Persians. Died of the wounds a few days later. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS IOVIANVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: General of the army of Emperor Julianus II. Proclaimed Emperor by the troops on the death of Julianus II. Reestablished Christianity as the state religion. Died of natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR PROCOPIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Maternal cousin to Emperor Julianus II. Military tribune during the reign of Emperor Constantius II. Military commander under Julianus II. Usurper, declared himself Emperor after the death of Jovianus. Defated by Emperor Valens and executed.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS VALENTINIANVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Military tribune under Emperors Julianus II and Jovianus. Elected to Emperor by the army on the death of Jovianus. Founder of the Valentinian dynasty. Made his brother Valens to co-Emperor in the East. Father of Emperors Gratianus and Valentinianus II. Died of natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS IVLIVS VALENS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Brother of Emperor Valentinianus I. Appointed co-Emperor in the East by Valentinianus I. Co-Emperor with his nephews Gratianus and Valentinianus II, Emperors in the West, after the death of Valentinianus I. Killed in action in the battle against Goths. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS GRATIANVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Valentinianus I and nephew of Emperor Valens. Half-brother of Emperor Valentinianus II. Appointed co-Emperor by his father Valentinianus I. Succeeded Valentinianus I as Emperor in the West (375). Co-Emperor with Valentinianus II in the West and Valens in the East. Appointed Theodosius I the Great as co-Emperor in the East (379) after the death of Valens. Taken captive and executed by the troops of usurper Magnus Maximus. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS VALENTINIANVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Valentinianus I and half-brother of Emperor Gratianus. Proclaimed Emperor by Pannonian army after the death of Valentinianus I. Accepted as co-Emperor in the West by Gratianus. Emperor in the West after the death of Gratianus, co-Emperor of Theodosius I in the East. Committed suicide or possibly murdered. Consecrated (apotheosis).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS MAGNVS MAXIMVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: General under Emperors Valentinianus I and Gratianus. Usurper in the West, proclaimed Emperor by troops in Britannia. After defeating Emperor Gratian, was legitimized as Emperor in Britannia and Gallia by Emperor Theodosius I (384). Defeated and executed by Theodosius I. Condemned (damnatio memoriae).

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS VICTOR AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Magnus Maximus. Received the title Caesar, after Magnus Maximus was recognized as Emperor in the West (384). Elevated to co-Emperor in the West by his father in 387. Executed after the deafeat of Magnus Maximus.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS THEODOSIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Military Commander under Emperors Valentinianus I and Gratianus. Governor of Moesia. Father of Emperors Honorius and Arcadius. Founder of the Theodosian dynasty. Appointed as co-Emperor in the East by Emperor Gratianus after the death of Emperor Valens. Co-Emperor in the East with Emperor Valentinianus II in the West (from 383). Sole Emperor after death of Valentinian II (393). Appointed his son Arcadius as junior Emperor in the East (383). Appointed his son Honorius as junior Emperor in the West (393). Died of natural causes. Consecrated (apotheosis). Canonized (Saint Theodosius) by Eastern Orthodox Church.

emperor.name: AELIA FLAVIA FLACCILLA AVGUSTA
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Theodosius I the Great (married 375-376). Mother of Emperors Arcadius and Honorius. Became Empress as Theodosius I was appointed Emperor in the East by Emperor Gratianus. Died of natural causes. Canonized (Saint Placilla) by Eastern Orthodox Church.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS EVGENIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Usupter against Emperor Theodosius I. Former teacher of grammar and rhetoric. Eugenius was an acquaintance of the magister militum Arbogast, de facto ruler in the West (under Emperor Valentinian II). Following the death of Valentinian II, Eugenius was elevated to Emperor by Arbogast. He was not recognized as Emperor by Theodisius I, who proclaimed his son Honorius to Emperor in the West. Defeated by Theodosius and executed.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS ARCADIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Theodosius I the Great and Aelia Flacilla. Brother of Emperor Honorius. Father of Emperor Theodosius II. Appointed as junior Emperor in the East by his father Theodosius (383). Became Emperor in the East after the death of Theodosius I (395). Died of natural causes.

emperor.name: AELIA EVDOXIA AVGUSTA
emperor.description: Wife of Emperor Arcadius (married 395). Mother of Emperor Theodosius II. Became Empress after the marriage with Arcadius, received the title Augusta on 9 January 400. Died of natural causes.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS HONORIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Theodosius I the Great and Aelia Flacilla. Brother of Emperor Arcadius. Appointed as junior Emperor in the West by his father Theodosius (393). Became Emperor in the West after the death of Theodosius I (395). Died of natural causes.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS THEODOSIVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor Arcadius and Aelia Eudoxia. Proclaimed Emperor in the East by his father Arcadius. Sole Emperor in the East after the death of Arcadius in 408. Died of natural causes.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR IOHANNES AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Senior civil servant (primicerius notariorum) under Emperor Honorius. Proclaimed Emperor in the West in the interregnum after the death of Honorius. Johannes was not recognized by Theodosius II, Emperor in the East. Executed after his defeat against the army of Theodosius II.

emperor.name: GALLA PLACIDIA
emperor.description: Daughter of Emperor Theodosius I and granddaughter of Emperor Valentinianus I. Queen consort to Ataulf, King of the Visigoths (414-415). Wife of Emperor Constantius III. Augusta in 421. Paternal half-sister of Emperors Arcadius and Honorius. Mother of Emperor Valentinianus III. Regent of her son (425-450). Died of natural causes.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS PLACIDIVS VALENTINIANVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Son of Emperor in the West Constantinus III and Galla Placidia, daughter of Emperor Theodosius I. Half-cousin to Emperor in the East Theodosius II. Appointed Emperor in the West by Theodosius II against Johannes. Assassinated by later Emperor Petronius Maximus.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS MARCIANVS AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Marcianus served under Aspar, the influential military commander of a Germanic army in Roman service. Made Emperor in the East by Aspar after the death of Emperor Theodosius II. Merried Aelia Pulcheria, sister of Theodosius II. Died of natural causes.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS LEO AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Military commander under Emperor Marcianus and Aspar. Appointed Emperor by Apar after the death of Marcianus. Grandfather of Emperor Leo II, father-in-law of Emperor Zeno. Died of natural causes. Canonized by Eastern Orthodox Church.

emperor.name: IMPERATOR CAESAR FLAVIVS ZENO AVGVSTVS
emperor.description: Military commander under Emperor Leo I. Married the daughter of Leo I in 466. Father of Leo II, who became Emperor in 474 after the death of Leo I. Became Co-Emperor of Leo II and sole Emperor after the death of Leo II in 474. Zeno's reign was interrupted from 9 January 475 to August 476 by usurpation of Basiliscus. Died of natural causes.
